title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct true or false answers for each statement.

title: Understanding of Phases
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of phase behavior at absolute zero and critical temperature.

title: Boiling Point Comparison
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly compare the boiling points of oxygen and nitrogen.

title: Thermodynamic Concepts
description: Important Criteria: The student should show knowledge of the coefficient of performance and its implications.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors in determining the truth values of the statements.
